This stands as a clear challenge to the structural inequalities where dominant players like the US and Israel prioritize maintaining control over addressing the systemic roots of these conflicts. As expected, Israel remains doubtful of any real Iranian acceptance and is escalating its assertions of pre-emptive strike rights, which only deepens the cycle of domination and endangers the security of vulnerable populations caught in between. Real progress will require institutional reform to dismantle these imbalances, rather than talks that just cover for ongoing aggression.
